scenes.title: 转不过弯的沙发
scenes.english: A sofa that will not turn
quotes: I just don't think it's gonna fit.
我觉得这根本放不进去。
Oh, yeah, it will! Come on. Up, up, up, up, up! Yes! Here we go! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot!
能放进去的！来，往上、往上、往上、往上、往上！对了！来吧。转！转！转！转！转！转！
Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
闭嘴！闭嘴！闭嘴！
Okay. I don't think it's gonna pivot anymore.
好吧，我觉得它转不动了。
You think?
你才发现啊？

scenes.title: 乔伊发现同义词词典
quotes: What... what you working on?
你……你在忙什么？
Oh, Monica and Chandler's recommendation. I want it to sound smart, but I don't know any big words or anything, so...
给莫妮卡和钱德勒写推荐信。我想写得有水平，可我不认识什么高级词汇，所以……
Well, why don't you use your thesaurus?
那你为什么不用同义词词典呢？
What'd I just say?
我刚才说什么来着？
Watch. Here, you, uh, you highlight the word you want to change, go under Tools...
看这里。你选中想改的词，再打开“工具”……
And the thesaurus generates, gives, gives a whole list of choices.
同义词词典就会生成，给出……给出一整列选项。
You can pick the word that sounds smartest.
你可以挑听起来最有学问的那个词。
Oh my God, that's great! I'm smart! No, no, I'm brainy, bright, clever. I love this thing!
天哪，太棒了！我真聪明！不，不，我是才思敏捷、机灵、睿智。我爱这个功能！

scenes.title: 选哪一半芝士蛋糕
scenes.english: Choosing a half of the cheesecake
quotes: All right, pick a half.
好，选一半吧。
Okay, well, this side looks bigger. Uh, there's more crust on this side. Y'know? So, maybe if I measured...
好吧。这边看着大一些。不过这边的饼皮更多。你看？要不我量一下……
Oh, for God's sake, just pick a piece!
天哪，你就随便选一块吧！
All right, pick that.
好吧，我选那块。
That's also the smaller piece.
那块也更小一些。
Okay. There you go. Enjoy your half, my friend, but that is it. No sharing, no switching, and don't come crying to me if you eat your piece too fast.
行，给你。好好享用你那一半吧，朋友。不过说定了，不分着吃、不交换。要是你吃得太快，可别来求我。

scenes.title: 退回半张沙发
quotes: It's cut in half.
它被切成两半了。
That's what I'm telling you.
我就是这个意思啊。
Did you cut this couch in half?
是你把沙发切成两半的吗？
This couch is cut in half. I would like to exchange it for one that is not cut in half.
这张沙发被切成两半了。我想换一张没有被切成两半的。
You're telling me this couch was delivered to you like this?
你是说，沙发送来时就是这样？
Look, I'm a reasonable man. I will accept store credit.
听着，我是讲道理的人。给我店铺购物额度也行。
I'll give you store credit in the amount of four dollars.
我可以给你四美元的购物额度。
I will take it.
成交。

scenes.title: 那个吸尘器配件是做什么的？
scenes.english: What is that vacuum attachment for?
quotes: Ta-da!
看！
Are we greeting each other this way now? Because I like that.
咱们现在这样打招呼了吗？我挺喜欢。
Look! I cleaned! I did the windows, I did the floors.
看，我打扫了！我擦了窗户，清了地板。
I even used all those attachments on the vacuum, except for that little round one with the bristles. I don't know what that's for.
我连吸尘器那些配件都用上了，除了那个带刷毛的小圆头。我不知道它是干什么的。
Oh, yeah, nobody knows, and we're not supposed to ask.
哦，没人知道，而且咱们还不能问。

scenes.title: 想象一下不马上付账单
scenes.english: Imagine not paying the bill immediately
quotes: All right, you madcap gal. Try to imagine this. The phone bill arrives, but you don't pay it right away.
好吧，你这位疯丫头。想象一下：电话账单来了，可你没有马上付。
Why not?
为什么不付？
Because you're a kook! Instead, you wait until they send you a notice.
因为你是个怪人啊！你偏要等他们发来催缴通知。
I could do that.
这我能做到。

scenes.title: 那个棕色罐子里装的是什么？
scenes.english: What was in that brown jar?
quotes: Well, you don't look good, Joe.
呃，乔伊，你气色不太好啊。
Well, the fridge broke, so I had to eat everything. Cold cuts, ice cream, limes.
冰箱坏了，所以我只好把里面的东西都吃了。冷切肉、冰淇淋、青柠。
And hey, what was in that brown jar?
对了，那个棕色罐子里装的是什么？
That's still in there?
那东西还在里面？
Not anymore.
现在不在了。
